description.value: Sabor Mexicano Restaurant is an authentic Mexican eatery on Kingsway in Vancouver with over 14 years of experience, serving traditional dishes including tacos, gorditas, burritos, birrias, tamales, and pozoles made with ingredients sourced directly from Mexico. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout, and also provides catering for events of all sizes. It has become a popular dining spot for locals and tourists in the Kingsway corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands at 25m; stands (7 spaces, covered) at 80m. Total: 7 spaces.
